name: Blackwolf River
summary: Through Windshear Crag, Blackwolf River carries runoff from the Venture Company's logging and industrial work. Its waters flow down from Cragpool Lake.

sections.title: Industrial Runoff
sections.body: Fed by Cragpool Lake, Blackwolf River runs through Windshear Crag. Venture Company loggers cut the surrounding woods with heavy machinery and buzzsaws. Sludge, oil, and logging waste drain into the current, carrying the cost of the company's work through the basin.

faq.q: Where does the Blackwolf River start and lead?
faq.answer: Blackwolf River flows from Cragpool Lake through the logged basin of Windshear Crag.

faq.q: Why is the river water polluted?
faq.answer: The Venture Company logs across Windshear Crag with heavy machinery. Runoff, waste, and clear-cutting foul the river.

faq.q: Who is currently operating along the river?
faq.answer: The Venture Company works along the river, harvesting lumber and operating machinery in the valley despite resistance from local wildlife and native inhabitants.

angles.text: As a druid, you can see how goblin timber work fouls Blackwolf River. Such work affronts the Cenarion Circle and those who revere Kalimdor's untamed waters.
As a tauren, you see outsiders scar the earth and foul its waters in search of profit. This strengthens your resolve to cleanse Stonetalon of reckless industrial blight.
